notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section, Pub. L. 101–42, § 2, June 28, 1989, 103 Stat. 91, which set out definitions, was omitted from the Code as being of special and not general application.

notes.heading: Short Title
notes.text: Pub. L. 101–42, § 1, June 28, 1989, 103 Stat. 91, provided that Pub. L. 101–42, enacting this subchapter, could be cited as the “Coquille Restoration Act”.

ancestors.heading: COQUILLE INDIAN TRIBE OF OREGON: RESTORATION OF FEDERAL SUPERVISION
